readout_other: Fluo-8 calcium fluorescence imaging; hydrophone acoustic spectra (second harmonic and broadband noise) to detect cavitation
direction_notes: Both frequencies evoked intracellular Ca2+ rises; 39.5 kHz responses occurred at lower intensities and coincided with second-harmonic (stable cavitation) energy, whereas 500 kHz responses occurred without cavitation signal.

timing.protocol_description: Sinusoidal drive with a pulse duration of 41.7 ms; intensity changed stepwise with 3 min between changes. Number of pulses per intensity and any repetition rate are not stated in the text.

flags.reason: Intensities were calculated from pressure measured in a water tank under progressive-wave conditions; the cultures were exposed in standing-wave conditions, so cell exposure is higher than stated. Recorded as free_field.
Only a 41.7 ms pulse duration is stated; PRF, number of pulses and sonication duration are not given in the text (timing schematic is Fig. 2b). Waveform left not_reported.
N = 6 dishes is stated in figure captions (Figs 3 and 4); whether the same count applies to both frequencies is not stated.
Transducers named with a supplier and part number only; classed other_manufacturer.
Paper uses cell culture to avoid off-target auditory responses but no auditory control is described.
